newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Political party leaders ask government to extend by two weeks amnesty for handing over illegal weapons which ends today.
Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna and Mahajana Eksath Peramuna to file action in court against Elections Commissioner over rejection of nominations lists for March 21 local government poll.
Government doctors plan to stage one-day token strike on Wednesday to back demands for better pay.
Political party leaders to issue joint appeal to voters to eschew violence during March 21 polls campaign.
Grenade explodes near President Chandrika Kumaratunga's residence in Nuwara Eliya, killing one Tamil student.
